prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use refined warm lifestyle editorial photography: considered light and composition with relaxed believable interaction, never a glossy advertising pose. Newlyweds aged 27 and 32 stand close together in a quiet garden, foreheads almost touching as they exchange a gentle smile. The bride holds a small loose bouquet below their faces; the groom hand rests at her upper back. Use a restrained medium-close paired portrait, soft overcast daylight, and realistic fabric and skin texture. Output a square 1:1 composition for a website gallery. Make the key expressions and interaction readable at thumbnail size, with breathing room around the subjects. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Additional subject and framing requirements: The bride has straight dark-blonde shoulder-length hair, brown eyes, and a slightly square face. The clean-shaven groom has short light-brown hair, grey eyes, and an ordinary angular face, without glasses. No beard. Exact square 1:1 with generous room around the couple and bouquet.
review: Reviewed square paired portrait: straight dark-blonde-haired bride with bouquet and clean-shaven light-brown-haired groom gently touching foreheads in a garden. Faces, groom hand on shoulder and bride hands around stems are coherent. Natural soft light and clear bouquet, no text.
